officialSources.operator: Kostroma Oblast unified cartographic-service geoinformation portal
officialSources.evidence: Official regional portal describes open access to regional spatial-data services and metadata catalogues. The inspected project page did not expose a parcel layer or feature endpoint. Its map page points to a Yandex embedded map, not a cadastral parcel service.

Official city page identifies the Rosreestr public cadastral map as the public resource where formed land parcels are published and gives a Kostroma cadastral number example. This is local custodial/procedure evidence, not a returned parcel API response.
Official federal cadastral-map route identified by first-party/local-government references; the route was not retrievable by bounded anonymous HTTPS request from this workspace.
Current official federal spatial-data route considered as the successor/current public map context; direct request timed out before configuration or feature data could be inspected.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official regional geoinformation-portal project page retrieved. No cadastral parcel schema, CRS, native ID field, or parcel feature service was exposed in the inspected HTML.
Official portal map page retrieved; it contains an embedded Yandex map and no parcel-feature endpoint. It is not treated as cadastral evidence.
Anonymous HTTPS request with normal TLS timed out after 20 seconds; no current JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry returned.
Bounded anonymous request did not return a usable response before timeout. No speculative API route was called after viewer/configuration access failed.
Official city page inspected for local registry/map custody evidence; it confirms public cadastral-map use but does not provide a machine-readable parcel response.

The regional portal is documented but does not expose a verified parcel service in the inspected pages.
